messages:
Alice Ng: Quick sync — need a scoped IaC deliverable for the cloud marketplace listing. Goal: a tiny, well-documented Terraform module set (1x core infra + 1x optional autoscale) that works for AWS and GCP. Target EOW. Can we scope and owners?
Carlos Ruiz: Sounds good. Are we doing AMI-based marketplace images for AWS and image-family + startup script for GCP? AWS has some stricter packaging rules.
Meera Patel: Yup, AWS needs marketplace package & hardened AMI doc, GCP wants image family + startup script. Keep example minimal: VPC, subnets, instance template/launch config, autoscaler, and a small nginx sample app.
Tom Chen: I'll own the AWS module (AMI packaging notes + manifest). Can we make the module accept either an ami_id OR use a build pipeline output variable? Example variable: `ami_source = "shared" | "custom"`
Jordan Lee: I'll take GCP. I'll add a sample startup-script and a small cloudbuild config. Also will add a small Helm alternative for later.
Carlos Ruiz: Quick implementation sketch for core.tf (very condensed):
```terraform
variable "region" { default = "us-west-2" }
resource "aws_vpc" "main" { cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/16" }
resource "aws_launch_configuration" "lc" { image_id = var.ami_id instance_type = "t3.medium" }
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "asg" { launch_configuration = aws_launch_configuration.lc.name min_size = 1 max_size = 3 }
```
Meera Patel: Perfect — add outputs for marketplace consumption: public_lb_dns, instance_count, ami_id_used. Also include a `example/` folder with `deploy.sh` and `README.md` that shows how to run locally and how to run the marketplace preflight checks.
Alice Ng: Partners legal/security asked for a simple checklist we can ship with the module: CIS baseline note, KMS integration optional, and a privacy note. Can someone draft that checklist?
Tom Chen: I'll draft the AWS checklist (AMI hardening steps, KMS tips).
Jordan Lee: I'll draft the GCP checklist and the cloudbuild snippet.
Carlos Ruiz: I updated the internal partner checklist doc and linked minimal packaging steps. partners-bot: added link to partners docs — https://redwood.internal/partners/marketplace-iac-checklist
partners-bot: NOTE: marketplace submissions usually take 3–5 business days after package upload. Remember to set licensing fields and pricing metadata.
Meera Patel: Action items: Tom = AWS module + checklist, Jordan = GCP module + checklist, Carlos = example repo structure + marketplace manifest template, Alice = coordinate legal sign-off and set EOW deadline.
Alice Ng: Thanks — please drop PR links into the thread when ready. If anyone hits policy friction ping me. :thumbsup:
Tom Chen: Will do. Expect first PR by Tue morning.
Jordan Lee: I have a prototype cloudbuild by tomorrow evening, will post here.
Carlos Ruiz: Creating repo skeleton now. I'll include `examples/simple` and `docs/marketplace.md`.
partners-bot: Reminder: add a LICENSE file and a clear README for marketplace reviewers to avoid delays.
